+does not attempt any optimisation – clarity and correctness are the goals.

+    orig_clauses: List[List[int]] = instance["clauses"]

+    neg_var: Dict[int, int] = {}

+    # It will be forced to false by a small gadget (see below).

+    next_var += 1
+    false_aux2 = next_var
